facts.fact: Nikolai 独自留守基地，其余三位继承人带 Max 前往 Greyhold
facts.quote: I’d held the base while the other three heirs rode to Greyhold with Max.

facts.fact: 急报称列车遭恶魔袭击、由拱魔领衔；Max 违背命令爬上车顶，替 Aelindor 挡下两支冷铁箭
facts.quote: And Max had climbed to the roof against orders and put herself between Aelindor and two Coldiron-tipped arrows.

facts.fact: Nikolai 得知消息后打翻桌上的棋盘，棋子散落大理石地面没有收拾
facts.quote: I knocked the chess board off the table. The pieces scattered across the marble, and I hadn’t picked them up.

facts.fact: Max 在站台上握住了 Nikolai 伸出的手
facts.quote: She took my hand. Her face flushed, her palm warm against my cool skin.

facts.fact: Max 指出 Nikolai 一直在喝瓶装血，并拒绝其他所有人
facts.quote: “You’ve been drinking from bottles,” she said. Not a question. “Bare minimum.”

facts.fact: Max 请 Nikolai 训练她，以便在去救 Missy 前做好准备
facts.quote: “Train me, Nikolai. I need to be ready before I go after Missy.”

facts.fact: Nikolai 安排四位继承人分工训练 Max，并承诺教她伪装与隐匿
facts.quote: “We’ll all train you,” I said. “Aelindor for magic. Caspian for hand-to-hand combat. Drakken for swords and battle strategy.”

facts.fact: Nikolai 把 Max 抱到餐厅，桌上摆着热面包和浓炖菜
facts.quote: I carried her to the dining room, where warm bread and thick stew waited.

relations: Nikolai 与 Max 有每周只从她一人取血的约定
Nikolai 为 Max 破例到站台迎接，当众无视军阶礼仪
Caspian 当众把手臂搭在 Max 肩上，屡次破坏 Nikolai 的安排
四位继承人共同承担 Max 的训练：Aelindor 教魔法、Caspian 教拳脚、Drakken 教剑术与战策、Nikolai 教伪装与欺骗
Nikolai 承诺在救回 Missy 时陪在 Max 身边
Max 是 Nikolai 唯一的供血来源，他已多日没从别人那里取血
Nikolai 把 Max 称作“我的姑娘”，Max 称呼他“prince”
